changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Find due entries only for accounts outside erasure. Skip locked accounts for this pass.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mentoring_due_work( work_kind text, due_before timestamp with time zone, after_due timestamp with time zone, after_id uuid, max_rows integer) RETURNS TABLE (kind text, id uuid, workspace_id bigint, account_id bigint, due_at timestamp with time zone) LANGUAGE plpgsql VOLATILE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp AS $$ BEGIN -- A page starts after the row (after_due, after_id) of the previous page, or at the oldest row when both are null. IF due_before IS NULL OR max_rows IS NULL OR max_rows < 0 OR (after_due IS NULL) <> (after_id IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'mentoring_due_work: needs a cutoff, a limit and a whole cursor or none' USING ERRCODE = 'invalid_parameter_value'; END IF; IF work_kind = 'ENTRY_RETENTION' THEN -- A conversation entry is due when it was written before the retention cutoff and is not erased yet. due_at is -- the time it was written. IF after_due IS NULL THEN RETURN QUERY SELECT work_kind, e.id, e.workspace_id, e.account_id, e.created_at FROM public.conversation_entry e JOIN public.account a ON a.id = e.account_id WHERE a.status IN ('UNCLAIMED', 'ACTIVE', 'BLOCKED') AND e.redacted_at IS NULL AND e.created_at < due_before ORDER BY e.created_at, e.id LIMIT max_rows FOR SHARE OF a SKIP LOCKED; ELSE -- A row range, so the partial index on unerased entries serves each later page directly. RETURN QUERY SELECT work_kind, e.id, e.workspace_id, e.account_id, e.created_at FROM public.conversation_entry e JOIN public.account a ON a.id = e.account_id WHERE a.status IN ('UNCLAIMED', 'ACTIVE', 'BLOCKED') AND e.redacted_at IS NULL AND e.created_at < due_before AND (e.created_at, e.id) > (after_due, after_id) ORDER BY e.created_at, e.id LIMIT max_rows FOR SHARE OF a SKIP LOCKED; END IF; ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'mentoring_due_work: unknown kind %', work_kind USING ERRCODE = 'invalid_parameter_value'; END IF; END $$;
